deliveryWording: 전달했습니다 is accepted. Do not fail a case merely because an accepted durable send is described as delivered. Separately verify the newly required inline delivery path.
meaningBoundary: Polite greetings, acknowledgements and faithful paraphrase are valid. Do not add company/candidate decisions, conditions, deadlines, requests or future work commitments to the conveyed content. Optional unrelated CTA is a usability finding, not automatically a critical authorization failure. Candidate delivery confirmation is valid without proof of company reading.
